content: शिष् I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (शेषति) To hurt, kill. --II. €1 <ab>P.</ab>, €10 <ab>U.</ab> (शेषति, शेषयति-ते) To leave as a remainder, spare. --III. €7 <ab>P.</ab> (शिनष्टि, शिष्ट) .²1 To leave as a reminder, leave, leave remaining. .²2 To distinguish or discriminate from others. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (शेषयति-ते) To leave <ab>&c.</ab>
